contribution_requirements: Follow existing architecture: @RestController + @Service + @Repository layers. Use Lombok (@Data, @RequiredArgsConstructor). Wrap all responses in ApiResponse<T>. Use @Valid + Jakarta Validation annotations on DTOs. Add @Transactional where data is written. Log meaningful audit events via AuditLogService. Never return passwordHash in responses.
key_patterns: All controllers in com.vps.controller, services in com.vps.service, DTOs in com.vps.dto, entities in com.vps.entity, repos in com.vps.repository, security in com.vps.security. AuthController/AuthService shows the request→service→ApiResponse pattern. AdminController shows @PreAuthorize usage. VehicleController shows @AuthenticationPrincipal UserDetails + authService.getUserByEmail() to resolve User entity. AuditLogService.log(user, action, entityType, entityId, description) is the audit convention. IllegalArgumentException→400 (bad input / not found), SecurityException→403 (ownership), IllegalStateException→currently mapped 409 but semantically used for 'account locked' so needs 403 mapping — fix by changing IllegalStateException handler to return 403.
